text: Any man will be secure in his position, however high it may be, if he does not behave himself in a haughty manner; and will be ever able to keep his wealth if he is frugal and careful in his expenses.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter III, The Filial Duty of Feudal Princes
